name: Myanmar
value: Junta claims resistance HQ near Mon–Bago line
summary: Junta says it took a resistance command and 10 bases on the Mon–Bago border; no major city has changed hands
state: State media said on 10 Nov that the army seized a NUG special region command and 10 other bases along the Mon state–Bago region border after a six-day operation; the claim could not be independently verified (Business Standard; The Star, 11 Nov). Military airstrikes on 1–2 Nov killed at least 15 civilians, including a newborn, at a maternity clinic and a school, according to local sources (The Star, 2 Nov). Searches on 16 Nov found no major city changing hands and no cross-border escalation, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in Rakhine, Sagaing, Karenni and Mon areas face airstrikes and displacement. Travellers should follow FCDO advice, which advises against travel to large parts of Myanmar. Border areas with Thailand, China and Bangladesh see refugee flows.
rubric_hit: Civil war at sustained intensity (Watch); no major city fallen or cross-border escalation (Alert line not met)
